description:
List your QA runs, newest first. Send templateId to filter by template.
Use for: finding a QA run or its report status.
Not for: reading one run’s findings and what each tester sent (get_qa_run).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_qa_runs({"templateId":"qa_tpl_4Rk9xW2"})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

templateId.description: The template id the QA template was created with.

name: list_qa_runs

data.description: Up to 100, without paging. Some newer runs may be missing.

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

reportOutcome.description: Left out until the run has a report.

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

status.description: blocked_awaiting_funds: waiting for money in your wallet. collecting: testers are applying and testing. reviewing: results are being checked. completed_settling: done, pay is being settled. closed: done, see report. cancelling, cancelled, expired, failed: over without a full result. unknown: the stored state could not be read.

testerCount.description: How many testers the run pays for.

title: List QA runs
